scope: Six ActualGramUniform modules, exact central ownership and full type/axiom audit; not a full-project compilation.

dependency_validation.policy: Reused available dependency objects read only; each of the six target modules was freshly compiled centrally. This inventory imports that exact central overlay. Complete module lists and full types remain in the private audit log.

type_encoding: UTF-8 SHA256 of exact complete pp.all pretty type and exact reprStr raw Expr; Lean UInt64 hash pins the pretty string in the executable audit; universe parameters pinned verbatim.
reference_encoding: SHA256 of UTF-8 JSON for the lexicographically sorted unique direct-used-constant string array, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(comma,colon), no trailing newline.
source_mapping: The only permitted source change qualifies each bare import ActualGramUniform* to import ZhangLS.Spec.ActualGramUniform*. Reverse those lines and verify the frozen original SHA256. All six files were byte-compared under that transform.
regressions: The exact 133 full elaborated type and universe pins are the scope regression checks; no duplicate theorem aliases or additional endpoint examples are claimed.
